Among the many [[Gank/Legends|Ganks]] employed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Smada]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'vouran]] was '''one''' who assaulted the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] in the [[Don't Go Inn]]. The Gank wielded a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and pointed it between Arranda's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], Smada told Arranda's caretaker, the [[Shi'ido]] [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]], that he must work for the Hutt as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]; the assault on Arranda was intended to emphasize Smada's seriousness regarding the matter. The Gank fled along with the Hutt master when the Human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] intervened in the confrontation, backed up by the Human [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
